audit.why: Pantheon holds lane priority every stage (Galio is mana-hungry, his R is a peel tool not a duel button); Galio's value is teamfight peel, so the difficulty lives in mid-late map play, not the lane. Content and packet chart agree Pantheon 7/7.
Spikes complete: 3-5 all-in, 6 duel still Pantheon's, 1st item priority/roams, late tempo. Grounded.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart carried Skill x6 plus a Galio row 7 whose own why described Pantheon winning — while content win[] and the packet give Pantheon 7/7. Cooldowns had no digits. Missing: Durand taunt / Hero's Entrance cancel the Aegis channel; Colossal Smash is an auto-reset burst tell. Two bleed bullets.
audit.why: Galio E Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7 — his only engage. W Shield of Durand (18s) is a taunt (hard CC) that cancels Aegis Assault's channel; his P is an auto-reset. These change when E can be committed.
audit.corrected: Chart sides aligned to Pantheon; taunt-cancels-channel folded into cooldowns; auto-reset tell folded into dosFull[1].d; bleeds replaced.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Aegis Assault like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — an 11s dash knockup at rank 1 (7 max); he has no engage while it is down. - His Durand taunt (18s) cancels your Aegis channel — commit E only after it is spent. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: Aegis faces down his tornado and the Colossal Smash proc — the block eats his whole burst if you face him.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: Galio can't punish your farm or follow your R — every wave you stall mid is a bot-lane play his Hero's Entrance wanted.

notes: Chart: content win[] and packet both give Pantheon 7/7; full carried Skill x6 plus a Galio final row whose own why described Pantheon winning ('Late Pantheon is a starting pistol...'). Sides aligned to Pantheon; rows 4-5 keep their 6/10 ratings and existing Pantheon-flavoured whys; row 6 rating eased to 6/10 and its existing why already matches. Residual tension the applier cannot resolve here: full diff says TRICKY 7/10 while the content layer paints a comfortable lane — diff/tone left alone since diffRating is champion-pair adjudicated by the mirror tools. Colossal Smash auto-reset and taunt-channel-cancel interactions folded in.
